title: You Have Hours Before London Burns, 1666 #history
description:
September 1666: a bakery fire on Pudding Lane, a strong east wind and tar-covered wooden houses. In four days over 13,000 houses and St Paul's Cathedral burned. Told from inside the story, in under a minute.

Would you survive? Comment SURVIVE or DEAD.
